claims: Administer supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 above 92% given tachypnea, mild dyspnea, and venous hypoxemia.
Obtain blood cultures and repeat lactate to evaluate sepsis given leukocytosis of 116.1 K/uL, lactic acidosis, and hypotension requiring norepinephrine.
Continue norepinephrine infusion for hemodynamic support and titrate to mean arterial pressure goal.
Administer intravenous calcium gluconate for ionized hypocalcemia (1.03 mmol/L) and total hypocalcemia (7.2 mg/dL).
Administer intravenous magnesium sulfate for hypomagnesemia (1.5 mg/dL).
Administer intravenous potassium chloride for hypokalemia (3.5-3.7 mEq/L).
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (metronidazole and ciprofloxacin) for suspected infection.
Monitor blood glucose and administer insulin per sliding scale for hyperglycemia (glucose 258 mg/dL).
Order continuous cardiac monitoring and serial vital signs given tachycardia (HR 107-111), tachypnea, and hypotension.
Perform chest imaging (chest X-ray) to evaluate for pulmonary infection or edema given respiratory symptoms and hypoxemia.
